scope: Browser prototype and proposed authoring contract only; no formal engine or protocol change.
objectRenderOrder: Declared by each object and its view: an interactable object may be behind the foreground. Visual depth never determines ownership or whether it is interactive.

layers.name: stable-backwall
layers.coverage: Opaque behind initially solid terrain as well as initial air; never regenerated by mining.

layers.name: foreground
layers.responsibility: Material, shape, durability, collision and occlusion; art is a read-only projection.

layers.name: mineral-grid
layers.responsibility: Mineral kind, durability, stock, depleted state; no per-cell or per-deposit ObjectInstance.

layers.name: interactive-objects
layers.formalOwner: Existing YYGC Definition / ObjectInstance / owning Behaviour state
layers.responsibility: Separate art and authoring anchor, approved Definition identity, collision and command contract as needed; no runtime object state baked into artwork.

layers.name: pure-decoration
layers.responsibility: May be grouped with matching visual layers; must be removed or masked when support changes.

runtimeInvariant: WFC chooses initial modules only. Mining and interactions do not re-solve WFC, respawn ore or move already placed objects.
